preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(t, int) and 1 <= t <= 10**4 for t in [int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.
For each test case, the first line is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) followed by exactly n non-empty strings, each of length at most 8.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) <= 8 and all(c.islower() for c in s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: Each string consists of lowercase English letters and has length at most 8.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) == sum(int(stdin.splitlines()[i*2]) for i in range(t)) and all(c in '01' for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output is a binary string where each bit corresponds to a string in the input. The i-th bit is 1 if the i-th string can be formed by concatenating two strings (possibly the same) from the input list, otherwise 0.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.strip()[i] == '1') == any(s_i == s_j + s_k for s_j in strings for s_k in strings) for i, s_i in enumerate(strings))
postconditions.description: For each string s_i in the input list, the corresponding bit in the output is 1 if and only if there exist two strings s_j and s_k (j and k can be equal) in the list such that s_i is the concatenation of s_j and s_k.
